name: Kimwolf
description: Kimwolf was a DDoS botnet operated by Jacob Butler ('Dort') of Ottawa, Canada, which flooded the anonymity network I2P and conducted attacks against corporate and government networks. Butler was arrested in May 2026 and charged by US federal prosecutors. Krebs covered the botnet extensively in 2025-2026, noting its use of corporate and government network infrastructure.

sources.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster 'Dort' Arrested — Krebs on Security
